summary: Engineering Manager with 10+ years of experience leading cross-functional teams to build scalable, high-quality software solutions in regulated, high-impact industries. Proven ability to mentor engineers through servant leadership, improve team performance, and deliver projects aligned with business goals through strong stakeholder and team collaboration.

items: Product, UX, QA, SRE, Data, and Executive stakeholder partnership

experience.description: Lead cross-functional teams of Developers, QA/SDETs, UX Specialist, Product Management, Site Reliability, and Data Analysts in delivering high-impact technology solutions in the Medicare Marketplace.

achievements.text: Lead team growth by hiring and onboarding nine professionals across Engineering, Product, UX, and Infrastructure functions.

Championed a servant leadership approach, building a team culture rooted in trust, autonomy, and career growth; Successfully coached an underperforming team member to a senior level promotion over the course of 4 years, while guiding multiple others to successful career advancements.
Delivered multiple successful projects on time and within budget including:
subAchievements: Standardized user profiles across the website and call center interfaces by performing gap analysis and providing technical direction; the updated interface is now adopted by 1,350 call center agents.

Improved the conversion rate for Underwritten Medigap applications from 75% to over 90% by identifying common data points and patterns across 50+ application variations and providing technical guidance for a new pre-screening process.

Modernized a legacy codebase handling all website participant data. Established a formal vulnerability and monitoring review process reducing open security alerts from 527 to 0 and high urgency Pager Duty alerts from 240 in a rolling 6 month period to an average of less than 10.

achievements.text: Facilitated user acceptance testing with agents and end users to drive adoption and ensure products met acceptance criteria, reducing incidents on production go-live to 0.
Created delivery dashboards for teams in excel and powerBI to track velocity, quality, and delivery. Drove a 10% increase in velocity, and 40% decrease in reported production bugs.
Collaborated with development teams and stakeholders on roadmap planning, providing effort estimates and feasibility input to executive leadership.

Guided team process using Scrumban, with the flexibility to operate full Scrum ceremonies when project cadence or team preference required. Led all ceremonies when required due to team member absence.

Acted as a stabilizing force during five consecutive Annual Enrollment Periods (AEPs), leading incident management and ensuring compliance to 99.9% uptime SLAs; Receiving accolades from senior level leadership.

experience.description: Led two major projects, acting as the accountable owner for end-to-end delivery, cross-functional coordination, and team alignment; communicating and overseeing the work of 5 individual contributors.

achievements.text: Mentored QA and junior developers in coding standards, test automation, and agile best practices; co-authored test suites with QA staff improving test coverage by 60%.

experience.description: Delivered high-quality code in C# and JavaScript for education-sector platforms, including performance tracking and evaluation tools.
Developed 50+ automated UI test cases using Selenium in C#, improving regression testing efficiency and reducing manual QA workload.
